{{Top|leg}}
'''Civil Intelligence''' was a branch of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Ministry of Education (Alliance)|Ministry of Education]]. Civil Intelligence focused on passive means of intelligence-gathering, such as monitoring media broadcasts and news. They also liaised with [[System Intelligence Branch]]es to ensure that the [[Alliance Civil Government/Legends|Alliance Civil Government]] was always kept up to date with the latest intelligence. Civil Intelligence was also charged with monitoring the Civil Government itself, watching for signs of infiltration by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
